subject: Post-demo: Eval readiness, econ sponsor confirmation & systems checklist
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@bluewing.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 10:12 AM -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Eval readiness, econ sponsor confirmation & systems checklist

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the demo time this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we can get the security intake started and confirm decision roles: 

- Decision/negotiation: you said Christina Alvarez (CFO) will be the economic sponsor and Procurement will own contracting. Can you confirm Christina's email and whether Procurement will need an RFP/PO or standard SOW?
- Security intake: attaching our lightweight questionnaire to kick off — the goals are to confirm systems in scope, data flows, and access model. Victor (security) looks like the right person to work with.
- Immediate asks from our side: a) current IDP/SAML authority + SSO owner b) network diagram showing outbound rules c) an initial list of environments (prod/uat/dev) that will be in scope.

Attachments: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf, sso-requirements-template.xlsx

Proposed owner/next steps: we’ll hand the questionnaire to Victor and loop in Monica (security lead) and Karthik (procurement/solutions) for contract pathing. If that sounds right I’ll drop a single-thread intake email to Procurement + Victor with the questionnaire and timeline.

Thanks — Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@bluewing.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluewing.io, Victor Lane <victor.lane@bluewing.io>
Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 11:05 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Eval readiness, econ sponsor confirmation & systems checklist

Hi Tessa — appreciate the clear summary. Confirmations below: 

- Economic sponsor: Christina Alvarez (christina.alvarez@bluewing.io). She’ll want a short cost estimate and a note on SLOs for latency/uptime.
- Procurement: procurement@bluewing.io — they typically ask for our commercial terms + SOC2 report. They prefer a short Statement of Work and a PO process; DocuSign is our normal flow.
- Security: looping Victor to take the questionnaire. Victor, can you review and tell us which environments/systems are in scope? I’ve attached a very rough network sketch (internal) — apologies for the roughness.

A couple of notes for your intake: we have PHI in one product line but the eval will only touch non-PHI telemetry. We’ll confirm boundaries in Victor’s intake. 

Thanks,
Alicia

Alicia Romero
Head of Product Partnerships
BlueWing Analytics
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Jun 3, 2027 at 14:22 PM -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo intake — BlueWing (please triage)

Monica / Karthik — forwarding BlueWing thread. Key asks: confirm systems in scope, verify PHI is out of scope for this initial eval, and capture any blocker items (SOC2, encryption at rest, VPC peering constraints).

Attachments forwarded: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf, bluewing-network-sketch.png

Monica — can you own the technical intake with Victor? Karthik — if Procurement wants an SOW template I can pull our standard SMB SOW, but flag if BlueWing will need enterprise terms.

Thanks — Ben
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Victor Lane <victor.lane@bluewing.io>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Jun 4, 2027 at 09:31 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo intake — BlueWing (technical intake + scope questions)

Hi Victor / team — thanks for the sketch and context. I’ll drive the security intake. Initial notes/questions after a first pass through the questionnaire: 

1) Environments in-scope: please confirm whether UAT will mimic prod (data subset) or whether UAT is synthetic. We’ll treat prod as in-scope unless you confirm otherwise.
2) Data types: Alicia noted PHI is present in another product line; to be safe we’ll require a written confirmation that no PHI or PII beyond hashed identifiers will flow to Redwood during the eval. If any telemetry includes PII we’ll need a data flow sample.
3) Network egress: we typically require outbound TLS only (443) and allowlisting of Redwood egress IPs or use of private endpoint. BlueWing: do you prefer allowlist vs VPC peering? Provide contact for infra (IP owner) so we can coordinate firewall rules.
4) Auth/SSO: please fill the attached sso-requirements-template.xlsx with your IDP issuer, ACS URL, attribute mappings, and SAML cert. If you need a SAML test window we can schedule next week.
5) Timeline: to meet Christina’s procurement window we suggest a 2-week intake window for security evidence (SOC2/arch diagrams) + a 1-week tech test. Is that feasible?

Requested artifacts: bluewing-network-sketch.png (you attached a version — thanks), a sample non-sensitive data payload (anonymized), and the completed SSO sheet.

I’ll open a JIRA intake ticket and drop baseline evidence we need. Once Victor confirms environments we’ll produce a short acceptance checklist for Procurement and Christina.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: sso-requirements-template.xlsx]
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia.romero@bluewing.io>, procurement@bluewing.io
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Victor Lane <victor.lane@bluewing.io>
Date: Fri, Jun 5, 2027 at 4:27 PM -0700
Subject: Next steps & intake checklist (BlueWing eval)

Thanks everyone — quick consolidated next steps so Procurement and Christina have what they need: 

1) Alicia / BlueWing: please confirm Christina’s PO flow and provide an estimated monthly token volume range for Christina’s cost estimate. Procurement: if you prefer a short SOW we’ll attach our standard SOW and commercial term sheet via DocuSign.
2) Victor: please confirm environments in-scope (prod/uat/dev) by EOD Mon 6/7 and return the completed SSO sheet.
3) Alicia: please share the anonymized sample payload and an updated network sketch (if available) to speed intake.
4) Monica: we’ll expect SOC2 summary and encryption-at-rest confirmation; if anything else blocks we’ll surface immediately to Christina.

I’ve added HubSpot record and a shared Drive folder to the related links. I’ll create the JIRA intake and include a checklist for Procurement to sign off once evidence is uploaded.

Attachments/links again: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf, bluewing-network-sketch.png, sso-requirements-template.xlsx
DocuSign template: https://www.docusign.com/templates/BW-SAML-LOA
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/bluewing
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-bluewing-eval

If that timeline works I’ll queue the JIRA ticket and schedule a 30-minute SAML test window for next week.

Best,
Tessa
